messages.text: I’ll audit the PR chain and post-merge records at the assigned revision, then identify any gaps and the smallest useful validation guard.

The chain preserves the frozen model history. The remaining gap is capture: the main-branch workflows publish committed observations, but do not collect merge state, labels or newly closed usage. Existing tracking and interaction records can hold that closeout; daily work labels and curated merge milestones need separate evidence.

`ECAL-CHAIN-SOFTENG-MERGE-AUDIT`, reviewed `b2b7041b045c0777c5e36176b4739336a41a97b5`.

Two capture gaps remain:

- Main-branch workflows validate and publish committed records; they **do not collect** new merge metadata, GitHub labels or closed-turn usage. After actual merges, refresh existing tracking, interaction and accounting records. No second registry is needed.
- At this revision, tracking lacks PR133; PR134–137 remain open snapshots with older heads. PR133–135 accounting remains unobserved. Daily work labels update from canonical usage; curated merge milestones require separate, actual merge evidence.

Minimum useful guard: a small read-only chain check covering all five tracking/interaction records, ordered head ancestry, frozen-commit reachability and unchanged model/core blobs. For merged entries, require `head → merge_commit → checked HEAD`; the current validator checks only `head → merge_commit`.

Actual checks passed:

- Main→133→134→135→136→137 ancestry.
- Freeze/results commits remain ancestors; frozen coefficients/core retain identical blobs.
- Project validation:107 tasks,54 documents,24 reviews.
- All five interaction ledgers recompute correctly against pinned canonical records.

The current generic ledger check reports stale derivations because the new untracked chain session already links these PRs; sync after closeout.

Historical milestone/tracking discrepancies also exist for PR14/55/58, so avoid introducing a global equality gate without reconciling them.

No writes or private usage access. Live GitHub readiness and deployed Pages were not rechecked; no future merge metadata or acceptance is inferred.

limitations: Only userMessage and agentMessage text retained; reasoning, tool arguments/results and private state excluded.
Conservative path, credential, email and URL redaction is not a privacy guarantee; review retained text.
Exposed operation counts are per retained turn; journal counts can describe the same invocations and must not be added.
Only started subagent activities establish child relationships; send/wait/completion activities remain operation counts and do not imply parenthood.
